all_candidates.topic: Should Education Minister resignations follow exam leaks?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Dharmendra Pradhan resigned as Education Minister on July 25, 2026, following student protests over the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak.

all_candidates.topic: Are AI-driven tech layoffs justified in India?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Reports from July 2 and July 9, 2026, indicate India is the second hardest-hit country by AI-driven tech layoffs.

all_candidates.topic: Should police using firearms in protests be dismissed?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Police personnel were suspended for firing an AK-47 during a student protest in Bihar's Siwan on July 25, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should police face strict guidelines during protests?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Supreme Court on July 27, 2026, considered framing uniform guidelines for police conduct during large-scale demonstrations.

all_candidates.topic: Is the new anti-paper leak bill truly effective?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026, was introduced in Lok Sabha on July 27, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should E20 petrol be mandated despite mileage concerns?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Nitin Gadkari stated on July 31, 2026, that E20 petrol can reduce fuel efficiency by 2-6% in some vehicles.

all_candidates.topic: Should airlines face stricter refund delay penalties?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Airline refund delays remain a 'genuine consumer problem' across India in 2026, with existing consumer court remedies highlighted.

all_candidates.topic: Should ride-hailing commissions be government-capped?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The government is still finalising Digital Mobility Service Operation Standards, 2026, with disputes over fare and commission caps as of July 30, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should India strengthen collective consumer redressal?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A LocalCircles survey reported on July 31, 2026, widespread dissatisfaction among Indian consumers over grievance redressal.

all_candidates.topic: Are increased railway fines good for discipline?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian Railways rolled out significantly tougher enforcement measures with increased fines effective July 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should UPI apps be allowed to block crypto payments?
all_candidates.news_anchor: As of July 31, 2026, while exchanges support UPI for crypto, individual payment apps may restrict transactions.

all_candidates.topic: Should special courts handle Manipur violence cases?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Supreme Court on July 24, 2026, proposed establishing special courts for speedy trials in Manipur violence cases.

all_candidates.topic: Should government ban apps for security concerns?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Home Ministry's cybercrime arm ordered GitHub to remove the Bluetooth-based messaging app Bitchat on July 24, 2026, citing security concerns.

all_candidates.topic: Should protest FIRs be uniformly withdrawn?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Delhi dropped 13 FIRs against CJP protesters on July 31, 2026, but other states have not yet followed suit.

all_candidates.topic: Should fuel blending beyond E20 be explored now?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Minister of State Suresh Gopi stated in Parliament on July 30, 2026, that any increase beyond E20 requires further technical studies.

all_candidates.topic: Should all new city buses be low-floor by October?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A new framework mandates all city buses produced from October 2026 onwards to be low-floor (announced Jan 19, 2026).

all_candidates.topic: Should religious institutions face financial audits?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Uttar Pradesh government set up an SIT on July 27, 2026, to probe alleged embezzlement of donations at the Ram temple in Ayodhya.

all_candidates.topic: Should India create a national smart transport mission?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs noted on July 30, 2026, that there is no 'National Smart Public Transport Scheme' per se.

all_candidates.topic: Is shifting the GST AATO window beneficial for taxpayers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: GSTN shifted the Annual Aggregate Turnover (AATO) amendment window for FY 2025-26 to July 1-31, 2026, from May.

all_candidates.topic: Should the GST E-Way Bill enhancements be deferred?
all_candidates.news_anchor: GSTN announced on July 29, 2026, that proposed e-Way Bill enhancements scheduled for August 1, 2026, have been deferred.
